thread:
Aisha (CS): Quick capture from onboarding call with Soluna — two product asks that are tied to renewal risk:
A) Cold-start latency on their low-tier workloads spikes to ~15s causing gateway timeouts.
B) They asked for per-route cache TTL so they can keep summaries cached for billing-sensitive routes.
They said renewal is in ~6 weeks and this is on the contract review checklist.

Carlos (PM): Thanks — can you share the exact wording they used for the cache TTL? and are they asking for an admin UI toggle or config-as-code?

Aisha (CS): Quote from their SRE: "We need route-level TTL control (30s-1h) so we don't pay for the same token sequence repeatedly on summary routes. Currently TTL is global and evicts too aggressively." They mentioned a config flag would be fine; UI would be nice but not required.

Priya (CS): I'll log this into the feedback tracker. Suggest we mark as P2 but tag with renewal-risk. Creating ticket now.

Ben (Eng): Short-term workaround: we can expose a routing-layer flag route.cache_ttl and honor TTL at the prefix/KV cache lookup. Spike should be <3d. Long-term: consider per-account warmup and prefix prioritization.

Kelsey (CS): Soluna asked for an ETA so we should either give a rough timeline or a workaround (increase burst capacity) — their legal asks start review next week.

Carlos (PM): Agree to P2 + renewal tag. Ben to own implementation spike. Priya create PRO ticket and include sample call logs. Aisha/Kelsey will manage customer comms.

Aisha (CS): Noted. I'll close the loop after the canary is up.

dev-bot: Ticket created: PRO-7890 — "Per-route cache TTL" — assigned to Ben (Eng), tags: [renewal-risk, onboarding, perf]. Link: https://redwood.internal/PRO-7890

Ben (Eng): I'll put a short PR outline in PRO-7890 tonight. If we can ship the flag in a canary within 2 weeks, we can give Soluna that ETA.

Priya (CS): PRO-7890 updated with call notes + sample logs + revenue tag. Added owner and estimated ETA field.

Aisha (CS): Perfect — I'll update the account health doc and ping the CSM on the renewal thread. Kelsey, can you send the customer a short note saying we're prioritizing a config flag and aiming for a 2-week canary?

Kelsey (CS): Yep — will send by EOD and include the workaround suggestion. :thumbsup:

Carlos (PM): Thanks all. Follow-ups: Ben posts spike summary, Priya links ticket to roadmap board, Aisha/Kelsey update customer-facing thread.

Aisha (CS): Noted. I'll close the loop after the canary is up.
